take: Columbus announced it has activated defenseman Ivan Provorov from injured reserve. He has played two games this season, scoring once, and Columbus controlled 60% of the quality chances (expected goals) at five-on-five with him on the ice. The Blue Jackets are 6-7-0 and get 45% of the quality chances overall, so his 19:45 a night on the second pair, the second power-play unit and the penalty kill matters. Dante Fabbro, who plays 14:24 a night, was next in line for those minutes and likely goes back to a smaller role.
